# python-course.eu

> A comprehensive, free online Python learning platform offering tutorials from beginner to advanced levels, with specialized courses in OOP, machine learning, numerical programming, and GUI development.

python-course.eu is an educational resource created by Bernd Klein that provides detailed, self-paced Python tutorials covering core language concepts, advanced topics, and practical applications. The site includes both free web-based content and professional PDF eBooks, supplemented by live training courses.

## Key Topics

- Python
- Object Oriented Programming (OOP)
- Machine Learning
- Numerical Programming
- Pandas
- NumPy
- Data Analysis
- Tkinter
- Advanced Python
- Beginner Guide
- Type Annotations
- Functional Programming
- Data Science
- Bernd Klein
- Programming Education

## Core Python Learning

- [Intro to Python Tutorial](https://python-course.eu/python-tutorial): Detailed online introduction course into Python programming suitable for self-study
- [For Loops](https://python-course.eu/python-tutorial/for-loops.php): Tutorial on for loops and iteration in Python with range examples
- [Annotations](https://python-course.eu/annotations): Guide to Python type hints and annotations for improved code quality

## Advanced Python & OOP

- [Intro to Object Oriented Programming](https://python-course.eu/oop): Introduction to Object Oriented Programming concepts and practices with Python
- [Intro to Advanced Python](https://python-course.eu/advanced-python): Advanced Python topics including functional programming, generators, and ML concepts

## Data Science & Numerical Programming

- [Numerical Programming with Python](https://python-course.eu/numerical-programming): Overview of NumPy, SciPy, Pandas, and Matplotlib for numerical computing
- [Multi-level Indexing in Pandas](https://python-course.eu/numerical-programming/multi-level-indexing-in-pandas.php): Advanced Pandas tutorial on multi-level and hierarchical indexing
- [Pandas Groupby Example](https://python-course.eu/numerical-programming/pandas-groupby-example.php): Practical Pandas example using groupby for data aggregation and analysis
- [Pandas Styling](https://python-course.eu/numerical-programming/pandas-styling.php): Tutorial on formatting and styling Pandas DataFrames for data visualization

## Machine Learning & Applications

- [Intro to Machine Learning with Python](https://python-course.eu/machine-learning): Machine Learning tutorial with examples using NumPy, SciPy, and Pandas
- [Introduction to Applications of Python](https://python-course.eu/applications-python): Practical Python applications including system programming, graphs, and state machines

## GUI Development & Projects

- [Tkinter - the Python interface for Tk](https://python-course.eu/tkinter): Tutorial on Tkinter, Python's most commonly used graphical user interface toolkit
- [Introduction to Projects](https://python-course.eu/projects): Small projects to practice Python concepts from beginner to advanced levels
